acceptance_checks.check: Independent card review first. Keep canonical Store format/name bank.sqlite and its old source/evidence unchanged; search-cache.sqlite3 is separate disposable private cache with its own verified schema/profile/generation, no receipt authority. Unknown cache rejected, never treated as empty valid index.

Explicit bounded build/rebuild validates retained supported documents/originals for one fixed canonical snapshot, streams exact bytes/hash. Atomically publish complete generation only after all selected corpus coverage/postings accounted for; faults/process death/partial generation cannot advance watermark. Appended commits outside watermark; old complete generation preserved or explicit unavailable.

BANK_SEARCH_R1 lexical profile exactly: NFC/casefold/NFC, L/N tokens and following M, independent field/alias values, AND unique query terms, no hidden fields/fetch/rendering/semantic/SQL/FTS interpretation. Strict text/plain UTF8 <=4MiB, exact exclusion/coverage states; integrity error never extraction exclusion.

Closed bounded BANK_QUERY bank.search request and supplemental result schema. Query <=1024UTF8bytes/32 nonempty distinct terms; types/fields/modes/limit/offset validated, SQL values bound; budgets selected before coding, no silent truncation or unbounded whole-corpus memory.

Posting relational algorithm agrees with manually expected IDs and independent oracle for every contract control and negative case. Current vs all_revisions at canonical S, coverage counts include no-token revisions, exact total_matches/has_more, required deterministic sort and matched_fields/extraction state.

Explicit S/null resolution and stable pagination after later updates/restart; W<S INDEX_NOT_READY, lost/corrupt cache INDEX_UNAVAILABLE, profile/Unicode mismatch INDEX_PROFILE_MISMATCH, unavailable snapshot/errors never empty OK. Old pinned hits reopen through verified read API. Complete search must detect affected original corruption after build; review bounded integrity proof/work budget before implementation, fail explicitly if verification cannot complete.

Native Windows actual secure-reader/importer/read integration, cache rebuild/restart/corruption/faults/profile/Unicode controls, save→search→pinned read→update→old reopen. No full-Unicode parity, real deployment/UI/private/hardware or R0/R1 release acceptance.

Record expected/observed per-case evidence, open→resolved issue history, Review Log, source/baseline hashes/backups/readback and next checkpoint. Mandatory unavailable requirement blocks component completion.

pre_execution_questions.question: How to keep complete-search integrity meaningful after index build within bounded work?
pre_execution_questions.proposal: Review targeted canonical integrity and cache generation binding, including post-build BLOB corruption. Select an explicit fail-closed per-query/work-unit budget; do not treat stale cache as evidence that originals remain intact. If an alternative changes scope/complexity substantially, record and seek that decision.

pre_execution_questions.question: How to bound generation rebuild and atomic publication without canonical schema changes?
pre_execution_questions.proposal: Separate cache-owned versioned generation staging/postings; iterate bounded canonical units and publish only after complete accounted corpus. Keep old generation/error semantics visible. Canonical filename is existing Store bank.sqlite, not the historical prose label bank.sqlite3.

boundaries.owned_resources: Synthetic private NTFS DB/cache roots and own processes only
excluded: Automatic canonical cleanup or release acceptance

next_action: Implement locally with independent fixture/oracle controls; guarded transfer then native evidence before completion.

implementation_decisions.integrity: Every search verifies canonical documents and every retained Asset bytes original through complete cache generation W in one canonical read snapshot, then recomputes entry/posting fingerprint and compares complete cache content. No trust in old watermark alone; fail closed on any limit or integrity problem. This is bounded prototype full-generation work, not a large-Bank throughput claim.
implementation_decisions.generation: Single separate derived SQLite transaction replaces corpus/postings/meta atomically, with fixed private cache path search-cache.sqlite3; old complete generation preserved on failure. Canonical Store untouched. No incremental resumable background worker in this task; over-budget build fails explicitly.
implementation_decisions.algorithm: Relational SQLite posting intersection; canonical targeted head lookup filters current at S; coverage/total count before page; generator iteration instead of whole corpus memory.
implementation_decisions.filenames: Use actual immutable Store bank.sqlite; historical BANK_SEARCH_R1 prose bank.sqlite3 is not a new physical-format/name authority.
